items.title: LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: LIMBO：面向 LLM 智能体的终身推理时记忆与预算优化
items.summary: LIMBO treats replayed experience as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly optimizes memory strategy and inference budget for each incoming task, learning the allocation online in a single pass without modifying the underlying agent. Across three LLM backbones on LifelongAgentBench it achieves better cost-accuracy tradeoffs than memory-augmented baselines, nearly matching the strongest at up to about 83% lower inference cost (53% on average).

items.title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: GraMRAG：通过图记忆与强化学习编排多智能体多步推理
items.summary: GraMRAG is a graph-memory-guided multi-agent RAG framework that formalizes agent reasoning as a dynamic directed acyclic graph, explicitly modeling action-observation dependencies to reduce state blindness and redundant retrieval. It combines a vision-text bridged ReAct-style toolchain with Topology-Aware Policy Optimization for critical-path identification and node pruning, reporting state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon multimodal reasoning benchmarks.

items.title: ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information
items.title_zh: ClinAgent：基于 ReAct 的临床试验信息对话式智能体
items.summary: ClinAgent is a conversational agentic RAG system that lets clinicians and researchers query clinical trial information in natural language across multi-turn interactions, using a ReAct LLM agent that selects among ClinicalTrials.gov search, PubMed and a Python analyzer over a locally cached trial dataset. In a three-phase evaluation comparing Gemini 3.0 Flash with DeepSeek V3.2 thinking and non-thinking variants, DeepSeek thinking excelled in planning quality while Gemini achieved the highest overall performance and expert ratings.

items.title: RA-CoA: Training-free Fashion Image Captioning via Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes
items.title_zh: RA-CoA：通过检索增强属性链实现免训练时尚图像描述
items.summary: RA-CoA is a training-free framework that retrieves relevant attribute sets from a product knowledge base and then performs attribute-level reasoning with a frozen vision-language model to generate fashion captions. Across diverse VLM families and prompting paradigms, it reports an average 26.3% METEOR gain over zero-shot captioning.

items.title: ShopEase: A Generative AI-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Customer Support Using Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: ShopEase：基于混合检索增强生成的企业智能客服多智能体框架
items.summary: ShopEase is a multi-agent customer-support framework combining intent, CRM, memory, hybrid RAG, escalation and supervisor components, with LLaMA 3.2 served locally through Ollama. On 2,632 held-out customer queries, FAISS-only dense retrieval reached 85.37% accuracy versus 55.74% for BM25-only, and cross-encoder reranking did not improve accuracy while adding latency.

items.title: youngyangyang04/llm-master
items.title_zh: llm-master：大模型全栈学习路线与中文教程
items.summary: A Chinese-language full-stack LLM curriculum that runs from beginner material to production practice, covering prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, MCP, fine-tuning, model deployment, Transformers, AI coding and interview preparation.

items.title: Clearailhc/clearai-dsh
items.title_zh: ClearAI：以本体为核心的原生 DSH 插件
items.summary: ClearAI is an ontology-first DSH agent preset that turns evidence-checked research into a browsable domain ontology.

items.title: Real-SWE: Benchmarking AI models on private, real-world, enterprise codebases
items.title_zh: Real-SWE：在私有真实企业代码库上评测 AI 模型
items.summary: Real-SWE benchmarks frontier AI models on private codebases drawn from real companies' production systems, covering seventeen models and twenty-five tasks.
